meta.description: Calls the Asset Manager automation API (asset_manager.automation.api) every 15 minutes: POST /ingest/run, which walks Drive raw_docs/ and chunks/embeds/upserts any new or changed files into Chroma (asset_manager.ingestion.ingest.run_ingestion). A polling schedule trigger is used rather than Drive's native push-notification trigger — simpler to set up and more reliable, and cheap to poll often given ingestion's own idempotency (unchanged files skipped via content-hash) and per-file resilience (one unsupported/corrupt file is recorded in failed_files and skipped, not a batch-aborting crash — see ingest.py). 'Run Ingestion' uses n8n's built-in onError: continueErrorOutput (two outputs: success/error) rather than manually inspecting a statusCode field on the response — the plain HTTP Request node's $json is just the parsed response body (e.g. {added, updated, ...}), with no statusCode/url fields present unless 'Full Response' mode is explicitly enabled, which this workflow does not use. Two alert paths: the node's ERROR output (API down, timed out, or returned a non-2xx) triggers 'Alert: API Unreachable' with the raw error JSON for diagnosis; a successful response that still reports failed > 0 (specific files that didn't parse) triggers 'Alert: Ingestion Files Failed', naming the files, while the rest of the batch still completed normally — distinguishing 'the API itself is broken' from 'the API ran fine but one document was bad', since ingestion has no SlackWebhookNotifier of its own to report the latter.
